counting_policy: Distinct correction entries, including behavior, boundary hardening and accessibility/polish. Related entries may share a root cause or implementation. These are not 100 independent production incidents. Previous CQ-001..120 and QF-001..200 are separate baselines.

findings.title: Option zero disappears from authored JSON
findings.trigger_and_before: Save or preview a question whose correct option is A; the answer field was absent.
findings.correction: Encode zero explicitly for authoring and use a separate redaction flag on learner reads.

findings.title: Zero scores disappear from catalog metadata
findings.trigger_and_before: A submitted assessment scored zero serialized without its score field.
findings.correction: Keep numeric zero in the public metadata contract so submitted results stay distinguishable from missing data.

findings.title: Whitespace-only board names
findings.trigger_and_before: Join with spaces as a display name; presence showed an empty-looking participant.
findings.correction: Trim names before applying the Guest fallback and length limit.

findings.title: Duplicate socket registration leaves phantom peers
findings.trigger_and_before: Connect the same socket twice; peer order contained it twice while the map retained one identity.
findings.correction: Return the existing peer ID without appending a second registration.

findings.title: Typed nil transports pass connection validation
findings.trigger_and_before: An integration passes a typed nil pointer as a socket; it was accepted and could panic on send.
findings.correction: Reject nil pointer, channel and interface transport values before registration.

findings.title: Non-comparable transport helpers panic
findings.trigger_and_before: Pass a slice or map to peer lookup helpers after room creation; map indexing could panic.
findings.correction: Apply the comparable-socket guard consistently to public peer operations and exclusions.

findings.title: Peerless rooms inflate active-room metrics
findings.trigger_and_before: Export or absorb a room with no connected peers; status counted it as active.
findings.correction: Count only rooms with at least one attached peer.

findings.title: Reset retains obsolete persistence errors
findings.trigger_and_before: Reset local board state after a failed save; LastPersistenceError still reported the old incident.
findings.correction: Clear asynchronous error state together with rooms and pending saves.

findings.title: Canceled broadcast removes healthy peers
findings.trigger_and_before: Cancel a broadcast context before or during delivery; healthy recipients were detached as transport failures.
findings.correction: Stop the broadcast on context cancellation without evicting recipients.

findings.title: Heartbeat races with idle eviction
findings.trigger_and_before: A peer sends fresh traffic after the sweep collects stale peers but before its turn is processed.
findings.correction: Recheck LastSeen under the room lock immediately before detaching the peer.

findings.title: Typed collections alias board snapshots
findings.trigger_and_before: Integrations pass typed point slices or nested maps; mutating input or returned snapshots could mutate live room state.
findings.correction: Recursively clone typed maps, slices and arrays while preserving their concrete types.

findings.title: Invalid element revisions enter ordering
findings.trigger_and_before: Negative, fractional, infinite or unsafe integer revisions could enter last-writer ordering and persistence.
findings.correction: Accept only finite, non-negative, safe integer revisions.

findings.title: Concurrent equal-version edits do not converge
findings.trigger_and_before: Two valid Excalidraw edits share a version but differ in versionNonce; arrival order determined the stored winner.
findings.correction: Use the lower nonce as the deterministic tie breaker, matching canvas reconciliation.

findings.title: Unchanged repeated joins generate redundant announcements
findings.trigger_and_before: Identity refresh or another join frame announced the same unchanged peer again.
findings.correction: Send init on rejoin while broadcasting presence only for first joins or actual identity changes.

findings.title: Detached sessions can process new frames
findings.trigger_and_before: Call HandleFrame after Close or eviction; a stale session could still issue protocol operations.
findings.correction: Reject closed or no-longer-registered sessions before dispatch.

findings.title: Canceled request suppresses peer departure
findings.trigger_and_before: Close a session using a canceled request context; remaining peers missed peer-left.
findings.correction: Detach once and announce departure using a cleanup context independent of request cancellation.

findings.title: Canceled WebSocket requests keep blocking
findings.trigger_and_before: Cancel the HTTP request while ReadMessage waits for a silent client; the handler and peer remained alive.
findings.correction: Close the connection when its request context ends and stop the callback during normal cleanup.

findings.title: Snapshots can load into the wrong room
findings.trigger_and_before: A backing adapter returns a snapshot with another room ID; Resume previously merged it.
findings.correction: Validate snapshot ownership before merging or restoring persisted content.

findings.title: Unsupported snapshot schemas load silently
findings.trigger_and_before: A future or invalid schema revision was treated like the current format.
findings.correction: Accept the current schema and legacy zero only, returning an explicit error for unsupported schemas.

findings.title: Invalid snapshot revisions damage room sequencing
findings.trigger_and_before: Negative or maximum int64 snapshot versions can corrupt the next room revision.
findings.correction: Reject invalid or immediately overflowing persisted revisions before applying them.

findings.title: Canceled loads become cached successes
findings.trigger_and_before: A store ignores cancellation and returns successfully; Resume marked the room loaded anyway.
findings.correction: Check request cancellation after loading and leave the room eligible for a later successful resume.

findings.title: Explicit flush ignores its caller cancellation
findings.trigger_and_before: A pending save retained its original writer context but also discarded a canceled flush caller.
findings.correction: Preserve writer identity values while honoring the flush caller's cancellation and deadline.

findings.title: Restore accepts a different requested revision
findings.trigger_and_before: LoadVersion returns a valid snapshot for another revision; the manager restored it without checking.
findings.correction: Compare the returned revision with the requested version before touching the live room.

findings.title: No-op permission changes create history
findings.trigger_and_before: Repeat the current students-draw setting; it incremented versions and wrote another snapshot.
findings.correction: Return without persistence or broadcast when the setting is unchanged.

findings.title: Admin token consumers disagree in one tab
findings.trigger_and_before: Save a token from one mounted hook; other consumers kept their previous local state.
findings.correction: Use one subscribed external store and notify every mounted consumer on writes.

findings.title: Admin token changes do not cross tabs
findings.trigger_and_before: Change or clear the token in another tab; existing consumers kept stale credentials.
findings.correction: Handle relevant local-storage events and full storage clears while ignoring other storage areas.

findings.title: Blocked storage loses shared ephemeral credentials
findings.trigger_and_before: A token write fails because storage is blocked; another component reading the token saw empty or old data.
findings.correction: Retain a shared in-memory fallback for the session and expose it consistently.

findings.title: Malformed socket envelopes crash consumers
findings.trigger_and_before: Valid JSON such as null, missing peers or non-array elements passed directly to callbacks.
findings.correction: Validate known message envelopes and ignore malformed frames before updating state.

findings.title: Queued old-socket callbacks affect a new room
findings.trigger_and_before: A queued event arrives after room replacement or disposal; it could update the current callbacks and presence.
findings.correction: Check both disposal and socket identity before processing open, message and close events.

findings.title: WebSocket constructor failures crash the page
findings.trigger_and_before: Browser policy or an invalid connection environment throws synchronously during socket construction.
findings.correction: Expose an unavailable state with a recoverable error instead of escaping the effect.

source.anchor: Could not open the board connection

findings.title: Synchronous send errors lose a drawing batch
findings.trigger_and_before: A socket closes between readyState checking and send; the exception escaped without buffering work.
findings.correction: Catch send failure, close the failed transport and retain the element batch for reconnect.

findings.title: Disconnected presence remains visible
findings.trigger_and_before: A connection closes but the participant list and self ID stayed visible until another init.
findings.correction: Clear disconnected presence immediately while reconnecting.

findings.title: Online recovery waits for exponential backoff
findings.trigger_and_before: The browser regains connectivity while a reconnect timer is waiting.
findings.correction: Attempt reconnect immediately on the online event and remove the listener during cleanup.

findings.title: Large drawing batches exceed the frame limit
findings.trigger_and_before: A normal gesture produces a multi-element batch larger than the server's 64 KiB limit and disconnects.
findings.correction: Split by encoded UTF-8 size with envelope headroom and explain an individually oversized element.

findings.title: One corrupt cache row discards the local scene
findings.trigger_and_before: A local snapshot mixes valid elements with null or malformed rows; the broad catch discarded everything.
findings.correction: Validate rows individually and recover the valid subset with normalized revision defaults.

findings.title: Duplicate cached IDs retain stale revisions
findings.trigger_and_before: A cached scene has repeated IDs in a different revision order; the last array row could overwrite newer state.
findings.correction: Keep the newest element revision and deterministic nonce winner for each ID.

findings.title: Board deltas arrive before the lazy canvas exists
findings.trigger_and_before: An elements frame arrives after init while the canvas module is still loading; the optional callback dropped it.
findings.correction: Merge early deltas into the pending remote snapshot until the canvas can consume them.

findings.title: An empty room still opens a socket
findings.trigger_and_before: A route normalizes to an empty room code; the error view appeared while its hook still connected.
findings.correction: Disable realtime transport for an empty room identifier.

findings.title: Repeated export clicks create overlapping downloads
findings.trigger_and_before: Click Export repeatedly while the persistence request is pending.
findings.correction: Use a synchronous export lock and a visible exporting state until completion.

findings.title: Board JSON downloads revoke URLs immediately
findings.trigger_and_before: The board export clicked an unattached anchor and immediately revoked its blob URL.
findings.correction: Reuse the attached-anchor download helper with delayed object-URL cleanup.

findings.title: Board download failures have no actionable feedback
findings.trigger_and_before: Blob URL creation or a download operation throws; the async event handler rejected without guidance.
findings.correction: Catch download errors, release the pending state and show a retryable failure message.

source.anchor: Could not download the board snapshot

findings.title: Constructor failure leaves no retry control
findings.trigger_and_before: Realtime is configured but socket construction fails; the unavailable state had no Retry now button.
findings.correction: Expose manual retry for recoverable unavailable connections as well as reconnecting ones.

findings.title: Room-code button lacks an explicit copy action
findings.trigger_and_before: The toolbar button's accessible name was only the code, leaving its purpose unclear.
findings.correction: Name the control with the copy action and complete room code.

findings.title: Heartbeat send exceptions escape the timer
findings.trigger_and_before: The socket closes during an interval heartbeat; send could throw outside the transport recovery path.
findings.correction: Catch heartbeat send failure and close the transport to enter reconnect handling.

findings.title: Late history restore replaces another room
findings.trigger_and_before: Change rooms or user identity while restore is pending; its late response applied through the current callback.
findings.correction: Capture the requested room and user scope and ignore a response after either changes.

findings.title: History restore controls are indistinguishable
findings.trigger_and_before: A screen-reader button list contains multiple controls all named Restore.
findings.correction: Include the target revision in each restore button's accessible name.

findings.title: Malformed history timestamps show Invalid Date
findings.trigger_and_before: A history adapter returns an invalid saved_at string.
findings.correction: Display a clear unavailable-time fallback instead of rendering Invalid Date.

findings.title: Standard dialogs exceed short viewports
findings.trigger_and_before: Open a tall dialog with a short window or virtual keyboard; top or bottom content can be unreachable.
findings.correction: Bound popup height to the dynamic viewport and allow internal vertical scrolling.

findings.title: Dialog headings overlap the close control
findings.trigger_and_before: A long dialog title reaches the top-right close button.
findings.correction: Reserve header space for the close control.

findings.title: Confirmations overflow very narrow screens
findings.trigger_and_before: The alert popup's full width and fixed maximum can reach viewport edges at small widths.
findings.correction: Keep a viewport-relative width with consistent outer margins.

findings.title: Long confirmations exceed the visible height
findings.trigger_and_before: A confirmation has long text or an error on a short screen.
findings.correction: Bound its height and scroll its contents so actions remain reachable.

findings.title: Unbroken names overflow confirmation titles
findings.trigger_and_before: An item title contains a long token without spaces.
findings.correction: Allow long confirmation titles to wrap anywhere within the popup.

findings.title: Pending confirmations are not communicated as busy
findings.trigger_and_before: A destructive request waits while controls are disabled, without exposing busy state.
findings.correction: Mark the dialog busy and announce the changing confirmation action label politely.

findings.title: Input-group addons do not focus textareas
findings.trigger_and_before: Click a text addon next to an InputGroupTextarea; the helper searched only for input.
findings.correction: Focus either supported editable control.

findings.title: Custom addon click handlers suppress built-in focus
findings.trigger_and_before: Passing onClick replaced the internal focus handler through prop spreading.
findings.correction: Compose the supplied callback with default focus behavior and respect preventDefault.

findings.title: Home catalog failures require a page refresh
findings.trigger_and_before: The assessment catalog fails but the error state offers only explanatory text.
findings.correction: Add a catalog retry control that refetches the failed query.

findings.title: Empty assessment searches lack a reset action
findings.trigger_and_before: Search and class/status filters produce zero results; recovery requires clearing several controls manually.
findings.correction: Reset search, status and classroom filters from the empty state.

findings.title: Empty room searches lack a reset action
findings.trigger_and_before: A room filter yields no results with only text suggesting that it be cleared.
findings.correction: Provide a clear-filter action in the empty state.

findings.title: Filtered assessment counts are silent
findings.trigger_and_before: Change filters while using assistive technology; the changing badge is not announced.
findings.correction: Expose the count as a named polite status.

findings.title: IME confirmation can submit authentication
findings.trigger_and_before: Press Enter to finish composing text in an authentication field; it also submits credentials.
findings.correction: Ignore Enter submission while the browser reports active composition.

findings.title: Recovery email fields enable unwanted typing assistance
findings.trigger_and_before: On mobile, recovery email entry can receive capitalization or spellchecking behavior.
findings.correction: Disable capitalization, autocorrection and spellchecking for the recovery address.

findings.title: Password visibility controls do not expose state
findings.trigger_and_before: Toggle password visibility in authentication or settings; only the label changes.
findings.correction: Expose the pressed state on all password visibility controls.

findings.title: Visible passwords can receive text autocorrection
findings.trigger_and_before: Show a password as text on mobile; default keyboard assistance can modify its contents.
findings.correction: Disable capitalization, correction and spellchecking on password inputs in both account flows.

findings.title: Profile edits made during save are overwritten
findings.trigger_and_before: Type another display name while an earlier profile update is pending; the response replaces that new edit.
findings.correction: Disable the profile input for its pending write.

findings.title: New credentials typed during a password change are erased
findings.trigger_and_before: Edit password fields while the mutation waits; successful cleanup clears those newly typed values.
findings.correction: Disable both password inputs and visibility controls while the request is pending.

findings.title: Overlong profile names fail only after submission
findings.trigger_and_before: Enter more than the server's 60-character profile limit with no field guidance.
findings.correction: Validate character count locally, explain the limit and disable invalid saves.

findings.title: Background profile refresh destroys unsaved names
findings.trigger_and_before: A same-user identity refresh updates the canonical name while a local profile edit is in progress.
findings.correction: Update pristine values on refresh and preserve an independently edited local name.

findings.title: Password instructions disagree with byte-based validation
findings.trigger_and_before: The settings description promises eight characters while the actual policy measures UTF-8 bytes.
findings.correction: Explain the 8–72-byte range and how non-ASCII text affects it.

findings.title: Settings password validation lacks input semantics
findings.trigger_and_before: A password field is visibly invalid but does not expose aria-invalid or its help text association.
findings.correction: Connect the live validation message to the input and expose its invalid state.

findings.title: Authentication validation is only visual
findings.trigger_and_before: Registration and reset fields show invalid styling without equivalent input semantics.
findings.correction: Expose invalid field states and associate password guidance with the relevant inputs.

findings.title: Builder validation is only visual
findings.trigger_and_before: Invalid time, duration or attempt settings color their groups without exposing input-level errors.
findings.correction: Add invalid state and associated guidance to the affected question-builder controls.

findings.title: Repeated prompts lack question context
findings.trigger_and_before: A teacher navigates text fields for several questions; every prompt is named Prompt.
findings.correction: Include the question number in each prompt's accessible name.

findings.title: Correct-answer controls hide their selected state
findings.trigger_and_before: The current answer is conveyed through a visual badge and button color only.
findings.correction: Expose the selected correct option with aria-pressed.

findings.title: Repeated option controls lack question context
findings.trigger_and_before: Option A and answer-selection controls repeat across multiple question cards.
findings.correction: Include the question number in option input and correct-answer action names.

findings.title: Repeated feedback fields lack question context
findings.trigger_and_before: Several feedback inputs have the same accessible name.
findings.correction: Identify each feedback field by question number.

findings.title: Repeated scoring fields lack question context
findings.trigger_and_before: Several point inputs have the same accessible name.
findings.correction: Identify each points field by question number.

findings.title: Bank-save actions lack question context
findings.trigger_and_before: A list of builder buttons contains several controls named Bank.
findings.correction: Name each save-to-bank action with its question number and purpose.

findings.title: Add-option actions lack question context
findings.trigger_and_before: Multiple question cards expose identical Add option controls.
findings.correction: Include the receiving question number in each add-option action.

findings.title: Remove-option actions lack question context
findings.trigger_and_before: A screen-reader action list repeats Remove option A across question cards.
findings.correction: Identify both the question and option being removed.

findings.title: Local draft actions are indistinguishable
findings.trigger_and_before: Several local rows expose identical Load controls.
findings.correction: Include the local draft title and storage context in the action name.

findings.title: Workspace draft actions are indistinguishable
findings.trigger_and_before: Several remote rows expose identical Load controls.
findings.correction: Include the workspace draft title and storage context in the action name.

findings.title: Question-bank reuse actions are indistinguishable
findings.trigger_and_before: Each bank row exposes a button named Use, without naming its question.
findings.correction: Include the question text in the reuse action name.

findings.title: Draft list titles are permanently truncated
findings.trigger_and_before: Long local or workspace draft titles cannot be distinguished visually in their rows.
findings.correction: Wrap full draft titles, including authored line breaks.

findings.title: Question-bank prompts hide distinguishing content
findings.trigger_and_before: Long bank prompts are truncated, concealing differences between similar questions.
findings.correction: Wrap complete question text and preserve authored line breaks.

findings.title: Workspace draft failures have no retry control
findings.trigger_and_before: Loading the remote drafts fails; only an error sentence is available.
findings.correction: Add a retry action while keeping local drafts available.

findings.title: Missing builder assignments appear unassigned
findings.trigger_and_before: Load a draft assigned to a class outside the current classroom list; the select has no matching option.
findings.correction: Keep an explicit unavailable-assignment option for the selected classroom ID.

findings.title: Duration zero conflicts with the builder's native minimum
findings.trigger_and_before: The backend supports zero for unlimited duration but the builder sets its numeric minimum to one.
findings.correction: Align the numeric minimum and guidance with the supported zero value.

findings.title: One invalid date can pass publish readiness
findings.trigger_and_before: Only one time boundary is invalid; the previous window expression short-circuits as valid.
findings.correction: Validate each supplied date independently before enabling publication.

findings.title: Import preview collapses multiline prompts
findings.trigger_and_before: A question prompt contains authored line breaks; preview collapses them.
findings.correction: Preserve prompt whitespace and wrap long words during review.

findings.title: Import preview merges choices into ambiguous text
findings.trigger_and_before: Options contain separators or line breaks; a joined paragraph obscures choice boundaries.
findings.correction: Render each option as a separate ordered list item with its answer marker.

findings.title: Import preview collapses feedback formatting
findings.trigger_and_before: A feedback explanation contains multiple lines or a long token.
findings.correction: Preserve line breaks and wrap feedback within the preview.

findings.title: Import format instructions are disconnected from inputs
findings.trigger_and_before: Assistive technology reaches the format or source field without its required data-shape guidance.
findings.correction: Associate both controls with the format-specific instructions.

findings.title: One reviewed import can be inserted twice
findings.trigger_and_before: Two activations occur before the cleared preview rerenders; the same reviewed batch is appended twice.
findings.correction: Guard insertion synchronously and reset the guard for a new preview.

findings.title: Workspace draft loading has no announced status
findings.trigger_and_before: The remote draft section shows only a skeleton while loading.
findings.correction: Give the loading region a named status for assistive technology.

findings.title: Question-bank loading has no announced status
findings.trigger_and_before: The empty local bank waits for its remote query with only a skeleton.
findings.correction: Give the bank loading region a named status.

findings.title: The not-found page lacks a main landmark and heading
findings.trigger_and_before: A user reaches an unknown route and cannot find a page heading or main landmark.
findings.correction: Use a main landmark and a real level-one 404 heading.

findings.title: The rendering-error page lacks announced structure
findings.trigger_and_before: A route rendering error shows plain paragraphs without alert semantics or a heading.
findings.correction: Use an alerting main region and a level-one error heading.

findings.title: Header ellipsis hides complete page context
findings.trigger_and_before: A narrow header truncates the title and description with no pointer-accessible disclosure.
findings.correction: Expose the full title and description through their title attributes.

findings.title: Roster rows hide full member identities
findings.trigger_and_before: Names and emails in roster rows are ellipsized, concealing the distinguishing part.
findings.correction: Wrap complete member names and email addresses within their table cells.

findings.title: Invitation cards hide full recipient identities
findings.trigger_and_before: Long recipient names and addresses are truncated in pending invitation cards.
findings.correction: Wrap full recipient details so teachers can verify the invitation destination.
